000.$description: Used by: dark text.row (Sampled (text)), light surface.card (Sampled).

100.$description: Used by: light bg.sheet (Sampled), light surface.close (Derived), light surface.iconSheet (Sampled).

800.$description: Used by: light text.subtitle (Sampled (text)), light text.value (Sampled (text)).

blue.$description: Settings icon tile: Search Engine, Change App Icon, Open App Links, Pinch to Summarize, Export Data. The same in both themes (#0053FF in light).

green.$description: Settings icon tile: Languages, Swipe to Navigate. The same in both themes (#0AAF00 in light).

yellow.$description: Settings icon tile: Auto-Open Keyboard, Block Trackers. The same in both themes (#FFC30A in light).

purple.$description: Settings icon tile: Archive Inactive Tabs, Add to Home Screen, Collapse Bottom Bar. The same in both themes (#CC49FF in light).

red.$description: Settings icon tile: Clear Browsing Data, Block Ads. The same in both themes (#FF2C52 in light).

tile.$description: Settings icon tiles: 4.3pt on a 28 pt tile, both themes. At this size the reading is plus or minus 2 pt.

pill.$description: Browse for Me buttons: 10.2pt on a 30 pt button (dark/02). Plus or minus 2 pt.

panel.$description: Panels inside the page menu (the list of Display Options to Request Desktop Site, Site Settings, the notice): 14.5pt from where the panel's straight edges meet.

tileButton.$description: The square Find on Page, Summarize, Pin and Share buttons in the page menu: 19.6pt.

group.$description: Grouped list cards in Settings (25.6pt) and the Archive's cards (25.6pt), in both themes.

sheet.$description: Top corners of a sheet (Settings): 47.8pt in light, the same as the screen's own corners. The dark sheet is too close to the dimmed page behind it to bound.

capsule.$description: Fully round ends: the Downloads and Archive buttons (20.5pt on 40 pt), the search field (22.2pt on 48 pt), the address bar (20.5pt on 48 pt), Done, Edit, the + button, the find bar and every round icon button.

screenMargin.$description: Left and right margin of grouped cards, buttons and the search field: the Settings groups start at x = 48 px, 16 px in from the screen's edge at 16.

groupGap.$description: Between two groups in Settings: one group ends at y = 563 px and the next starts at 633 (edges.groups).

buttonToGroup.$description: Between the Downloads and Archive buttons and the first group: 407 to 459 px.

buttonGap.$description: Between the Downloads and Archive buttons: the flat fills end at x = 396 px and start at 415, with one anti-aliased pixel at each edge between them.

row.$description: Settings row (icon tile and one-line label), tile to tile. A group of two rows is 103.5 pt tall (size.group).

rowLauncher.$description: Launcher and suggestion rows under the search field, label to label (56.0pt dark, 55.8pt light).

rowHistory.$description: Archive history row (favicon, title, URL), favicon to favicon.

rowMenu.$description: Page menu list row (Display Options to Request Desktop Site), label to label.

tile.$description: Settings icon tile: 27x27.5pt with its anti-aliased edge left out.

button.$description: Downloads and Archive buttons: 174.5x39.5pt, two side by side.

addressBar.$description: Address bar at the top of the page menu: 48.5pt between its rims in both themes.

findField.$description: Find field: 49pt dark, 48pt light between its rims. Plus or minus 1 pt.

iconButton.$description: Round glass icon buttons in the find bar: the close button reads 49pt dark and 50pt light between its rims, the find field beside it 48.

pill.$description: Browse for Me button: 100.5x30.5pt dark, 101x30.5pt light.

plus.$description: The + (new tab) button in the bottom toolbar: 76x40.5pt.

tileButton.$description: Square buttons in the page menu (Find on Page, Summarize, Pin, Share): 77x77.5pt, four across.

closeButton.$description: Round close button in a sheet's header (App Icon): 41.5x42pt.

confirmButton.$description: Round accent button at the Archive's top right: 43x41.5pt dark, 44x41pt light with the anti-aliased edge left out, so 44 pt.

navButtonHeight.$description: Edit and Done capsules in a nav bar: Edit is 62x44pt.

searchBar.$description: Archive search field at the bottom of the screen: 274x48pt with a 48 pt round close button beside it.

width.$description: Switch track: 62x27pt with the anti-aliased edge left out, so 64 x 28 pt, the iOS 26 switch.

thumb.$description: Switch thumb, a white capsule wider than it is tall: 36x23pt in dark.

touchTarget.$description: Rows, the confirm button and every round icon button are 44 pt or more; Browse for Me (30 pt) and the + button (40 pt) sit in taller rows.

hairline.$description: Separators inside a group, inset to start at the label: two anti-aliased device pixels at 2x (border.separator).

base.$description: Not determinable from pixels. The labels look like SF Pro, the iOS system font, but a screenshot cannot prove it; use the platform font.

regular.$description: Row labels, values, history titles and URLs, helper text, menu items. Judged by stroke width, not measured.

medium.$description: Button labels (Downloads, Archive), the notice. Judged by stroke width.

semibold.$description: Nav and page titles, Done, section headers, Browse for Me, the space name. Judged by stroke width.

spaceTitle.$description: The space's name at the top of its sheet ('Main'). Cap-height readings: 24pt.

search.$description: Text and placeholder in the launcher's search field ('Search...'). Cap-height readings: 20pt.

navTitle.$description: Nav and page titles: Settings, Default Search Engine, Archive. Cap-height readings: 17pt.

body.$description: Settings rows, row values, helper text over a group, pop-up and context menu items. The line height is the two-line helper's. Cap-height readings: 17pt.

button.$description: Labels on capsule buttons (Downloads, Archive, Done, Edit). Cap-height readings: 17pt.

row.$description: Launcher rows, suggestions, history titles, page menu rows. Cap-height readings: 16pt.

sectionHeader.$description: Archive day headers (Today, Yesterday) and a sheet's title (App Icon). Cap-height readings: 16pt.

notice.$description: The first line of the page menu's notice ('Arc scrubbed 5 ads and trackers'). Cap-height readings: 14pt.

caption.$description: Second lines: a settings row's subtitle, the notice's second line, history URLs. Cap-height readings: 12pt.

pill.$description: Browse for Me button labels. Cap-height readings: 12pt.

tileLabel.$description: Labels under the page menu's square buttons (Find on Page, Summarize, Pin, Share). Cap-height readings: 11pt.

notTokenised: Glass: launcher, toolbar, page menu, find bar, pop-up and context menus are translucent materials over the page and take its colour; the glass tokens are readings of one moment
Space gradients: each space has its own colour (Main is plum to green); the gradient tokens are Main's
Shadows and blur radii of the glass: not measurable from stills
Line heights of one-line labels: only the two-line helper was measured

page.$description: Full-screen pages: the Archive and its search. The iOS grouped background.

sheet.$description: Settings and its sub-pages, a sheet over the browser. Lighter than bg.page in dark, darker in light.

dimmed.$description: The page behind the Settings sheet, darkened (dark) or greyed (light) while the sheet is up. A mean over one moment's page.

group.$description: Grouped list cards and capsule buttons on the Settings sheet: one grey for both.

card.$description: Grouped list cards on bg.page (the Archive).

sheet.$description: A secondary sheet over Settings (App Icon).

control.$description: Edit capsule in the Archive's nav bar (opaque grey in dark, white glass in light). The box's dominant colour covers 32% of it (a gradient, glass or a thin mark), so it is a reading, not an exact fill.

close.$description: Round close button in a sheet's header (glass; white with a soft edge in light). The box's dominant colour covers 90% of it (a gradient, glass or a thin mark), so it is a reading, not an exact fill.

navButton.$description: Done capsule on the Settings sheet. A reading of glass over the page: it takes the colour of whatever is behind it.

launcher.$description: The launcher sheet under the search field. A reading of glass over the page: it takes the colour of whatever is behind it.

searchField.$description: The launcher's search field, a capsule a step lighter (dark) or darker (light) than the sheet. A reading of glass over the page: it takes the colour of whatever is behind it.

pill.$description: Browse for Me buttons on the launcher. A reading of glass over the page: it takes the colour of whatever is behind it. The box's dominant colour covers 88% of it (a gradient, glass or a thin mark), so it is a reading, not an exact fill.

toolbar.$description: The bottom toolbar (tabs, +, page menu). A reading of glass over the page: it takes the colour of whatever is behind it.

plus.$description: The + capsule in the toolbar. A reading of glass over the page: it takes the colour of whatever is behind it.

menu.$description: The page menu sheet. A reading of glass over the page: it takes the colour of whatever is behind it.

panel.$description: Panels inside the page menu (the list, Site Settings). A reading of glass over the page: it takes the colour of whatever is behind it.

address.$description: The address bar in the page menu. A reading of glass over the page: it takes the colour of whatever is behind it.

tileButton.$description: Square buttons in the page menu. A reading of glass over the page: it takes the colour of whatever is behind it.

notice.$description: The notice panel at the bottom of the page menu. A reading of glass over the page: it takes the colour of whatever is behind it.

findField.$description: The find field in the find bar. A reading of glass over the page: it takes the colour of whatever is behind it.

popup.$description: Pop-up menu (Archive Inactive Tabs). A reading of glass over the page: it takes the colour of whatever is behind it.

searchBar.$description: Archive search field floating over the list. A reading of glass over the page: it takes the colour of whatever is behind it.

separator.$description: Hairline between rows of a group, inset to start at the label.

primary.$description: Row labels, titles, button labels, history titles, suggestions.

secondary.$description: Row values ('Google', 'After 7 days'), the typed part of a suggestion, the helper over a group, second lines. Readings in this role: #5D5356, #7A7A7A, #858585, #858587.

tertiary.$description: Disclosure chevrons and the pin glyph on a pinned row.

url.$description: URL line under a history title.

onAccent.$description: The tick on the accent confirm button.

onGlass.$description: Labels on the page menu's glass panels (light: a dark grey that takes the glass's tint).

onGlassSecondary.$description: Second lines on glass (the notice's 'Problems? Tap to restore original page').

tileLabel.$description: Labels under the page menu's square buttons (white in dark, a muted grey in light).

findCount.$description: The match count in the find field ('1 of 2').

default.$description: Arc's blue-violet: the round confirm button in the Archive. Lighter and softer in dark, a saturated blue in light. The box's dominant colour covers 88% of it (a gradient, glass or a thin mark), so it is a reading, not an exact fill.

check.$description: Tick on the chosen row of a choice list (Default Search Engine).

link.$description: Text actions in a list ('Add Search Engine').

caret.$description: Text caret in the search field, in the accent colour: the only focus indicator seen. A reading of two pixel columns. The box's dominant colour covers 13% of it (a gradient, glass or a thin mark), so it is a reading, not an exact fill.

text.$description: Destructive menu item ('Remove Favorite') on a glass context menu.

textOnControl.$description: Destructive action in the Archive's Edit capsule ('Clear All').

onTrack.$description: Switch on, track: the iOS green.

thumb.$description: Switch thumb: white in both themes.

top.$description: The Main space's gradient near the top of its sheet (plum). Each space has its own colour.

bottom.$description: The Main space's gradient near the bottom (green).

title.$description: The space's name over its gradient.

danger.$description: Danger: the destructive menu red. No success, warning or info colour appeared.

notTokenised: Switch off: every switch in Arc's settings is on, and none was changed
Success, warning and info colours: no such state was seen
Pressed and disabled states: stills only, and no disabled control appeared
Glass tints: they follow the page behind the glass
